home.kicker: A chess variant with a second life
home.title: Chess gets
home.description: Capture a piece and it becomes yours to drop back onto the board. Every trade opens a new route into the position.
home.footnote: Free to play · No account · Your games stay on this device
home.botDescription: Six levels, from a gentle first game to a sharp tactical test.
home.localDescription: Pass the board back and forth. Captures still go into each player’s pocket.
home.onlineDescription: Invite a friend by link or code, or find an opponent for a timed game.
home.learnDescription: Short interactive lessons for captures, drops, special moves and endings.
home.ruleTeaser: A dropped piece can block check, attack the king, or change a quiet position in one move.

learn.kicker: A field guide to the pockets
learn.title: Learn Crazyhouse
learn.description: Work through the rules at your own pace. Each lesson puts a real position under your hand.
learn.intro: Capture, pocket, and drop. Learn how the familiar chess board changes when every piece can return.

rules.title: The board remembers every capture
rules.description: The pieces move as in chess. The pocket is what makes this game different.

capture.title: Capture
capture.body: The captured piece changes sides and enters the capturer’s pocket.

drop.title: Drop
drop.body: Spend a turn to place a pocket piece on any legal empty square. It may give check or mate.

pawn.title: Pawn drops
pawn.body: Pawns cannot be dropped on ranks one or eight. Same-file pawns and pawn-drop mate are legal.

promoted.title: Promotion
promoted.body: Promoted pieces are marked in the position. If captured, they return to hand as pawns.

ending.title: Endings
ending.body: Checkmate, stalemate, threefold repetition, and the 50-move rule apply. Repetition includes pockets and promotion markers.
